Personal Banking: Financial Access,
Stability and Progress

Personal Banking is the backbone of PPB’s social
and economic footprint. In 2025, the business
supported over 200,000 individuals through
accessible, affordable and increasingly digital
financial solutions.
Key areas of value creation include:
• Access to home ownership, with Stanbic
Bank recognised as the Number One Bank in
Affordable Housing by total disbursements in
2025.
• Employee Value Banking, which supported
salaried individuals across government and
large private institutions with predictable,
responsibly priced credit for life needs
such as education, healthcare and home
improvement.
• Purpose‑led digital lending and partnerships,
including education and small‑ticket lending
solutions, which expanded access to credit
for customers traditionally underserved by
formal banking.
